text: 据伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社，伊朗经济与财政部长今天星期天抵达莫斯科，旨在进行双边和多边磋商。其在莫斯科的日程安排是与俄罗斯财政部长会晤、在金砖国家和上海合作组织框架内进行磋商，以及参加伊朗和俄罗斯商人交流会议。
text_en: According to Iran's Tasnim News Agency, Iran's Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance arrived in Moscow today, Sunday, for bilateral and multilateral consultations. His schedule in Moscow includes meetings with the Russian Finance Minister, consultations under the BRICS and Shanghai Cooperation Organization frameworks, and participation in an exchange meeting between Iranian and Russian businessmen.
